Description: Main single-board computer for C++ and OpenCV processing
High-performance A2 storage card for the operating system and saving 3D point clouds
Active cooler and heatsink to prevent CPU thermal throttling during 3D triangulation
1.6MP Global Shutter camera module for stereoscopic vision without motion blur
Line laser modules for scanning sweep, operating at 520nm for clean HSV filtering
Mirror sheets to build the 6 first-surface outer plane mirrors for the hexagon
2mm rigid styrene sheet used as the non-reflective hexagonal base
Stepper motor used for the automated laser sweep line rotation mechanism
Structural aluminum T-slot profiles to build the main frame structure of the scanner
